2c5a94d3c8986adb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاركان العربية عن مدير تسويق وإدارة متجر إلكتروني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى قيادة نمو المتجر الإلكتروني للشركة، وتعزيز حضور العلامة التجارية، وزيادة المبيعات والتحويلات الرقمية. يتطلب الدور تخطيطاً تسويقياً فعالاً وإدارة يومية للمتجر. المهام والمسؤوليات الأساسية إدارة المتجر الإلكتروني بشكل يومي، بما في ذلك متابعة تجربة المستخدم، وتحديث المنتجات، والعروض، والمخزون، وضمان سلاسة عمليات الطلب والشحن والدفع. وضع وتنفيذ خطط وحملات التسويق الرقمي عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، ومحركات البحث، والإعلانات المدفوعة، والبريد الإلكتروني، بما يتوافق مع أهداف المبيعات المحددة. تحليل بيانات الأداء والزيارات وسلوك العملاء ومعدلات التحويل، وتقديم تقارير دورية وتوصيات لتحسين العائد على الاستثمار (ROI). تحسين ظهور المتجر والمنتجات في محركات البحث (SEO) ورفع كفاءة صفحات المنتجات لزيادة المبيعات. التنسيق مع فرق التصميم، وخدمة العملاء، واللوجستيات لضمان اتساق الهوية التسويقية وجودة الخدمة المقدمة. متابعة السوق والمنافسين والاتجاهات الحديثة في التجارة الإلكترونية لاقتناص الفرص الترويجية والموسمية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال التسويق الرقمي وإدارة المتاجر الإلكترونية. القدرة على التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتنفيذ الفعال للحملات التسويقية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لفهم بيانات الأداء واتخاذ القرارات المبنية على البيانات. معرفة متعمقة بأدوات وتقنيات تحسين محركات البحث (SEO) والتسويق عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الدمام، المملكة العربية السعودية. أوقات العمل المحددة هي من السبت إلى الخميس، من الساعة 8 صباحاً حتى 5 مساءً. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

2ca2432966d42d1f.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن حاجتها لحاضنة أطفال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على توفير الرعاية الشاملة للأطفال، وضمان بيئة آمنة ونظيفة لهم، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم جداولهم اليومية لضمان مشاركتهم في الأنشطة المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم الجداول اليومية للأطفال بما يضمن أداءهم للنشاطات الثقافية والترفيهية اللازمة وحصولهم على قسط كافٍ من الراحة. ضمان نظافة سكن الأطفال وترتيبهم بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. العناية بالأطفال على كافة الصعد الدينية والصحية والاجتماعية والأخلاقية، وتقديم الرعاية التربوية الشاملة لهم. الالتزام التام بكافة الإجراءات والسياسات المتعلقة بحضانة الأطفال والمحافظة على قواعد وسياسات السلامة العامة. إعداد التقارير الفنية عن سير العمل ورفعها إلى الرئيس المباشر، وتوضيح الصعوبات التي تواجه سير الأعمال والعمليات في أماكن العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال رعاية الأطفال أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنظيم وإدارة جداول الأنشطة اليومية للأطفال. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة العامة. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، وتوفر بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة لضمان رعاية الأطفال بشكل فعال وآمن. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية. القدرة على التواصل الفعال. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة.

2cd7d5108d8edc4b.description: About the Role Talent Diamond is seeking a qualified Project Management Trainer on behalf of a leading training center located in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves preparing individuals and corporate teams to effectively plan, manage, and deliver projects. The trainer will utilize project case studies, planning exercises, and practical tools to facilitate the application of project methods in the workplace. Training Content The curriculum for this role covers a range of essential project management topics. Trainers with specialized expertise in Agile, Scrum, PMP, or CAPM preparation are encouraged to specify the particular programs and exam preparation they are qualified to deliver. Project scope definition Scheduling and timeline management Budgeting and financial planning Resource planning and allocation Risk identification and management Stakeholder communication strategies Project monitoring and control Project closure processes Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess a strong background in project management and training delivery. Practical project examples are required to enhance the learning experience. Professional project management experience Relevant qualifications such as PMP, CAPM, Agile, or Scrum, where applicable Demonstrated experience in delivering structured training programs Strong facilitation skills Application Information Trainers from around the world are invited to apply. Please include your current location, the languages in which you can deliver training, your specific qualifications, and your availability for in-person delivery in Jeddah, online delivery, or both.

2c0addb27491caa0.description: Description Asas Alhirfa is seeking a skilled 3D Designer specializing in furniture, kitchens, cabinetry, and custom woodwork design. The role is responsible for developing detailed designs, preparing technical drawings, and converting design concepts into production-ready files. The ideal candidate should have strong technical design skills, experience with 3D modeling and AutoCAD, and the ability to prepare cutting lists and CNC files to ensure accurate and efficient manufacturing. Key Responsibilities: Design kitchens, cabinets, wardrobes, and walk-in closets based on client requirements and project specifications. Design wooden doors, decorative woodwork, TV units, and custom furniture products. Develop 3D models, renders, and detailed design layouts for furniture and woodwork projects. Prepare technical drawings, dimensions, and detailed specifications for production. Prepare CNC files in DXF format and ensure designs are suitable for manufacturing. Prepare cutting lists, material requirements, and production drawings. Coordinate with production teams to ensure design accuracy, feasibility, and proper execution. Review and modify designs based on client feedback, technical requirements, and production needs. Ensure accuracy of measurements, materials, dimensions, and design details before production. Support production teams in resolving technical issues related to drawings and design files. Required Qualifications: Minimum 3 years of experience in furniture, kitchens, cabinetry, or woodwork design. Experience designing kitchens, cabinets, wardrobes, doors, TV units, and wooden decorative products. Proficiency in 3D Max or SketchUp. Proficiency in AutoCAD. Experience preparing CNC files in DXF format. Ability to prepare cutting lists and manufacturing drawings. Strong understanding of furniture design, wood materials, dimensions, and manufacturing processes. Attention to detail and accuracy in technical drawings. Ability to work full-time on-site at the factory in Riyadh. Preferred Qualifications: Diploma or bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Furniture Design, or a related field. Experience working directly with CNC machines and production teams. Knowledge of furniture manufacturing techniques, materials, and hardware. Ability to join within 30 days. Comprehensive medical insurance coverage. Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations. Paid annual leave and public holidays. Professional development and training opportunities.

2c4e66efe521fbc9.job_title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist Financial Services Audits
2c4e66efe521fbc9.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Specialist to support a major financial-sector regulator in Riyadh. This full-time position requires a dedicated individual to work 100% onsite with the client. The role focuses on strengthening security operations and leading compliance assessments against Saudi cybersecurity frameworks. Key Responsibilities Assess and enhance security operations across various domains, including SOC monitoring, EDR, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response. Review and recommend improvements for SOC processes, use cases, playbooks, and escalation procedures. Oversee vulnerability management activities, including scanning, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting. Review IAM and privileged access controls, covering joiner-mover-leaver processes, MFA, PAM, and access reviews. Lead or support incident response efforts, including triage, containment, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting. Plan and conduct audits and gap assessments against the SAMA Cyber Security Framework (CSF) and NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC). Track audit findings and remediation plans through to closure. Prepare executive reports on cyber risk, control effectiveness, and compliance status. Collaborate with the client's IT, risk, internal audit departments, and third-party security providers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in cybersecurity. Demonstrated hands-on depth across SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response. Required Skills Clear communication skills, with the ability to report effectively to senior management and auditors. Work Environment This role requires a commitment to work 100% onsite in Riyadh, providing dedicated support to the client. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

2c54720a9725d131.job_title: Sales & Marketing Executive / Business Development Executive
2c54720a9725d131.company_name: Yes Yem Yech for Industrial Services Co. (SMH)
2c54720a9725d131.description: About Growth Solutions Company Growth Solutions Company, established in 2023, is a Saudi-based provider specializing in human capital consulting, recruitment solutions, and workforce services. Operating under the license of the Ministry of Commerce, the company is headquartered in Saudi Arabia with offices in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Growth Solutions focuses on assisting organizations in attracting, managing, and retaining talent through structured service frameworks, advanced information systems, and strategic partnerships. The company aims to deliver reliable workforce solutions that generate value for clients, employees, and the community, with a vision to be a leading provider of integrated human capital solutions supporting client success and national development. The Role of Sales and Marketing Representative Growth Solutions Company is seeking a Sales and Marketing Representative to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for driving business growth by identifying new opportunities, building client relationships, and promoting the company's human capital and workforce solutions. Key Responsibilities Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand the client base. Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with clients. Promote the company’s portfolio of human capital and workforce solutions to prospective clients. Conduct sales calls and meetings to present services and negotiate terms. Prepare and deliver compelling presentations tailored to client needs. Follow up on leads to convert prospects into long-term clients. Support marketing campaigns and initiatives to enhance brand visibility. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure sales activities align with overall marketing strategies. Gather market insights to contribute to the refinement of service offerings. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within CRM systems. Prepare and submit regular sales reports detailing performance and progress. Participate in ongoing training and development activities to enhance product and market knowledge. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active engagement with clients and internal teams within a dynamic work setting.

2cd99a305e28a35b.description: About the Graduate Programme Mace Consult offers a two-year Graduate Programme designed to provide hands-on experience and professional development. This programme allows participants to contribute to projects from the start, focusing on areas such as sustainable places, infrastructure, and client solutions. The Work Winning role is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a start date in early September 2027. This role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of work experience. Role Overview and Responsibilities As a Graduate in Work Winning, you will gain practical experience on live projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across the built environment. Your responsibilities may include supporting project delivery, planning, design coordination, cost and commercial management, sustainability, risk assessment, data analysis, or client engagement. The programme also incorporates structured learning, professional development, and mentorship, alongside networking opportunities through community initiatives and industry events. Work Location and Travel The primary employment location will be the Mace office in Riyadh or one of our client sites. Work locations may vary based on project assignments within the Kingdom. While most projects are in Riyadh, some graduate roles may be located approximately 40km outside Riyadh. Candidates must be comfortable with daily commuting to such locations. Flexibility and an adaptable approach to travel are essential. Mace Consult reimburses eligible business travel expenses in line with company policy, including mileage, public transport, and accommodation when required. For sites difficult to access by public transport, a valid driving licence or access to a vehicle is necessary. Qualifications and Requirements Completion or anticipated completion of a bachelor’s degree or higher by September 2027 in one of the following subjects: Architecture or Architectural Design, BIM, Building Surveying, CIAT-accredited Architectural Technology, Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Design Management, Digital Construction, Engineering, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or any other built environment-related subject. No more than one year of prior work experience. A GPA score of or above. Mastery of the English language (verbal and written). Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation. Saudi Arabian nationality. Desired Attributes We are seeking proactive individuals who demonstrate curiosity, a growth mindset, and confidence. Candidates should exhibit resilience, commitment, reliability, and drive. The ideal candidate will think creatively, respond positively to change, act with integrity, and align with Mace Consult's core values: safety first, client focus, creating opportunity, and integrity. Desired behaviours include being curious, collaborative, contributory, and a champion of inclusion. Competencies sought are the ability to build effective teams, embrace change, solve problems, and build trusted relationships. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The anticipated closing date for applications is Sunday, 28th February 2027. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the vacancy may close early if a sufficient number of applications are received. The Emerging Talent team will review all submissions, and outcomes are expected to be communicated to both successful and unsuccessful candidates by early April 2027. Due to the volume of applications, individual feedback cannot be provided at this stage.

2c9d259e0d2e9ecb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة عناب للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدوادمي، الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة التجهيزات والمعدات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الدوادمي، الرياض. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

2c23a282dcf78324.description: About the Role of Enterprise Data Architect Devoteam is seeking an Enterprise Data Architect to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves translating business requirements into technology specifications, defining data standards, and designing the organization's enterprise data management framework. The architect will provide a common business vocabulary, outline high-level integrated designs, and align with enterprise strategy. Key Responsibilities Facilitate the establishment and execution of the roadmap and vision for information delivery and management, including enterprise data warehousing, big data, BI & analytics, content management, and data management. Translate business requirements into technical specifications, covering data streams, integrations, transformations, databases, and data warehouses. Collaborate with data engineers to architect and deliver solutions that meet business information needs and align with the information vision and strategy. Apply business strategy while driving technology strategy, balancing short-term and long-term needs to ensure architectural scalability and evolution. Engage an end-to-end approach by connecting all data pieces to deliver data, leveraging available assets. Provide advice, guidance, direction, and authorization for major plans and procedures to ensure schedule attainment, product development process adherence, and performance and budget targets are met. Define the data architecture framework, standards, and principles, including modeling, metadata, security, reference data (*, product codes, client categories), and master data (*, clients, vendors, materials, employees). Define various data architecture artifacts such as conceptual data models, logical data models, physical data models, and integration catalogs. Define reference architecture as a pattern for creating and improving data systems. Define data flows, including which parts of the organization generate and require data, how data flows are managed, and how data changes in transition. Collaborate and coordinate with multiple departments, stakeholders, partners, and external vendors. Required Qualifications and Experience Strong expertise in assessing current data architecture, identifying gaps, and addressing key challenges. Proven ability to gather and translate business requirements into effective data architecture designs. Extensive experience in developing reference data architecture frameworks. Skilled in documenting both current-state and target-state data architectures. Well-versed in selecting appropriate data principles, industry trends, and standards to guide architecture decisions. Experienced in choosing suitable content metamodels to align with business and data needs. Broad knowledge of data integration technologies, patterns, and best practices. Hands-on experience with data processing tools (ETL/ELT) and modern storage solutions such as data lakes and lakehouses. Proficient in data modeling using tools like ERwin and ARIS. Strong background in business process modeling and alignment with enterprise strategies. Solid understanding of Saudi Arabia’s national regulatory requirements (NDI, NDMO, QIYAS, NORA) and practical know-how to ensure compliance. Advanced SQL skills with experience in relational databases and distributed database systems like SingleStore and Vitess. Experience with a range of NoSQL databases, including Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, Elasticsearch, and the ELK Stack.

2c384a53ca658a64.description: About the Role Baker Hughes is seeking an Engineer Fleet Management to join the Regional Product Service Engineering team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves supporting the operation and maintenance of heavy-duty gas turbines, aero turbines, centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, and their associated control, protection, and accessory systems. The successful candidate will contribute to global energy solutions within a dynamic industry. Role Overview As an Engineer Fleet Management, you will be responsible for providing timely technical solutions for heavy-duty gas turbines and their auxiliary systems. This position focuses on upholding Baker Hughes' product integrity by proactively identifying customer issues, investigating technical anomalies, and providing technical assessments at both component and system levels. You will communicate Baker Hughes' technical solutions directly to customers. Key Responsibilities Respond to internal and external customer requests for technical issue resolution, applying technical product knowledge and analytical skills while adhering to engineering principles, standards, practices, and procedures. Escalate issues as needed, acting as a liaison between field and design engineering to drive specific technical resolutions and assist engineering in identifying and implementing corrective actions. Establish and maintain customer relationships to ensure technical issues and requirements are understood and addressed promptly. Lead and program manage root cause analysis and investigation activities for product technical issues, interfacing with Product Service, System, and Design Engineering teams. Provide technical leadership to personnel supporting projects aimed at resolving customer technical issues. Prepare technical presentations for Baker Hughes leaders and customers, ensuring timely communication of significant issues or developments. Travel to customer locations to support technical review meetings, present recommendations, and champion Baker Hughes' commitment to technical solutions. Support unplanned/forced outages to meet reliability and availability goals. Provide commercial teams with technical support for sales and services proposal activities. Plan and provide technical engineering oversight to Contractual Services and Field Services teams during planned outages to achieve reliability and availability targets. Partner with Design Engineering teams and interface with external and internal suppliers to facilitate the logistical implementation of Fleet Program technical solutions. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant engineering field. Demonstrated technical product knowledge and analytical skills. Ability to adhere to sound engineering principles, standards, practices, and procedures. Strong communication skills for presenting technical information to both internal and external stakeholders. Work Conditions This role offers flexible working patterns, including the ability to adjust daily work hours to optimize productivity. The position involves working with customers on-site at various global locations. While on-site, work patterns will align with customer schedules. Upon project completion, opportunities for extended leave are available before commencing the next project.

2c6367cde4faa4d4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برافو للمقاولات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التقارير المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. معرفة بإعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. مهارات في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. بيئة العمل سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق شركة برافو للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بالمهام المحددة لضمان سير العمليات المالية بكفاءة ودقة. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع البيانات المالية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة المستندات والسجلات. القدرة على التحليل المالي وإعداد التقارير. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة في شركة برافو للمقاولات بالرياض.

2c6e3dcbbc410aef.company_name: شركة كاد الشرق الاوسط للصناعات الدوائية
2c6e3dcbbc410aef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بنى الجزيرة للمقاولات عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية من خلال تحديد المخاطر المهنية وتطبيق الإجراءات الوقائية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في مواقع العمل. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين ظروف العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المهنية المختلفة (كيميائية، فيزيائية، إشعاعية، بيولوجية). معرفة جيدة بمعايير ومستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج المقبولة. القدرة على تصميم برامج لمنع الأمراض المهنية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة بنى الجزيرة للمقاولات في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة الدمام. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة لتقييم المخاطر وضمان تطبيق إجراءات السلامة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص في شركة بنى الجزيرة للمقاولات، حيث يمكن للمرشح المساهمة في تعزيز بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

2c8af891f3461a4b.job_title: Engineer Methods Structural & Lifting; Zone D
2c8af891f3461a4b.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Engineer Methods Structural & Lifting for Zone D to join their team in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves preparing and reviewing design analyses, calculations, and procedures for various structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard environment. The position focuses on ensuring the safety, efficiency, and reliability of critical engineering operations, including both in-service and pre-service analyses. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review design analyses, calculations, and procedures for structural in-service and pre-service engineering deliverables, such as hull structure design, transportation, lifting, installation, vessel deck layout and modification, hull structure erection, and ship lift. Demonstrate familiarity with project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and inter-discipline requirements, identifying concerns and taking appropriate initiatives. Interface with other departments to obtain necessary input for discipline designs and drawings. Maintain close coordination with other disciplines and entities, including Engineering, Project Management Team, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction. Assist in preparing estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and man-hour estimates. Raise technical queries to clarify work scope, obtain missing information, and ensure adherence to company procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements. Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications as required. Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity. Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as necessary. Assist the procurement team in acquiring discipline equipment, materials, and services, ensuring compliance with company objectives and procedures. Review vendor and subcontractor submittals for compliance with project specifications, providing comments as needed. Keep the supervisor informed of all activities and concerns related to technical, budgetary, and manpower aspects. Provide input for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports, including associated productivity. Assist concerned parties with responses to the Company and other entities (*, certifying authorities, auditors, third parties) regarding their review and approval. Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience in the domain. Experience Required Candidates should possess between 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard environment. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia.

2c9c5b03f72da266.description: About the Role Raytheon is seeking a Generator Wiring Technician for a full-time position based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This critical role supports the sustainment of Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems, focusing on the improvement and repair of generators or AC units. The technician will provide essential technical assistance to existing customer personnel and perform other related duties as directed by the section officer under the approved TAA. Key Responsibilities Participate in on-the-job training (OJT) programs and assist the section officer in enforcing safety policies, procedures, and standards. Perform troubleshooting, fault isolation, and field maintenance repair for diesel generators or air conditioners within RSADF systems covered under the approved TAA. Troubleshoot Patriot System generators for electrical and mechanical faults. Test generators or AC units under various tolerance states to ensure compliance with all specifications. Participate in necessary maintenance performance, including wiring and inspecting engines and fans. Perform all necessary parts inspections on RSADF Depot Test Equipment (DTE) and work on generator DTEs for inspection and testing. Operate balancing machines. Participate in preventive maintenance operations across all maintenance levels. Implement approved engineering changes. Provide assistance during the inventory, inspection, organizational level repair, and checkout of MEIs. Qualifications and Experience Typically requires an AA/AS degree or other 2-year post-high school training. A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience is required, with a total experience range of 5-10 years. Basic job knowledge in troubleshooting, fault isolation, and repair of various types of diesel power generation equipment or air conditioners. Ability to follow basic work routines and standards through on-the-job training (OJT). High school, secondary school, or equivalent education is necessary. Experience in troubleshooting, fault isolation, repair, testing, and checkout procedures. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, supporting Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems. The role involves working within a team to ensure the operational readiness and sustainment of critical defense infrastructure.

2cd61beb72fa5ccc.job_title: Mechanical Lead Design Engineer (Mining and Mineral)
2cd61beb72fa5ccc.description: About the Role EHIF is hiring a Mechanical Lead Design Engineer (Mining and Mineral). This full-time role involves leading design activities for mining and mineral processing projects, from concept through detailed design phases. The primary objective is to ensure designs are safe, reliable, cost-effective, and compliant with relevant standards. Company Overview Wood, a global leader in consulting, engineering, and operations for the energy and materials sectors, is part of Sidara's Energy & Materials pillar. With 33,000 employees across approximately 50 countries, Wood supports clients throughout the asset lifecycle, focusing on delivering predictable outcomes, resilient operations, and a lower carbon future. Key Responsibilities Lead mechanical design and engineering efforts for mining and mineral processing facilities. Prepare and review mechanical design criteria, equipment specifications, datasheets, technical requisitions, calculations, and engineering reports. Manage the mechanical scope across concept, study, FEED, detailed design, and construction support phases. Lead the layout, design, selection, and integration of process plant equipment, including crushers, SAG and ball mills, HPGRs, screens, feeders, conveyors, chutes, pumps, slurry transport systems, thickeners, agitators, tanks, dewatering systems, stackers, reclaimers, and mechanical packages. Coordinate and interface with process, piping, civil, structural, infrastructure, electrical, instrumentation, and project teams. Conduct technical bid evaluations and support procurement activities, including reviewing vendor designs for integration. Lead design reviews, risk assessments, and value engineering initiatives. Ensure compliance with Wood and project requirements, industry standards, and safety regulations. Interface with clients, contractors, equipment suppliers, and other stakeholders. Mentor engineers and designers, supporting discipline development. Manage changes effectively. Conduct supplier visits, inspections, and acceptance testing. Employee Support and Development Wood is committed to supporting its employees through various programs. These include specialist medical care for eligible family members, an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support on work or personal issues, and company-paid social insurance contributions in line with government legislation. Employees are also eligible for an End of Service benefit as per KSA Labour Law. The company supports professional growth by covering the cost of one professional membership, registration, subscription, certification, or license per annum, provided it is relevant to the role or a development plan. Wood also emphasizes continuous learning and development through structured growth, goal setting, and active coaching and mentoring from managers to help employees achieve career goals. Additionally, an annual awards program recognizes and celebrates inspirational colleagues, and long service milestones are acknowledged to demonstrate appreciation for dedication and loyalty. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

2cdbf2d6687f20e4.description: About the Role DallahHealth is seeking a dedicated Physiotherapist for a full-time Home Care role in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This position involves providing comprehensive physiotherapy services to patients in their homes, assessing their needs, and developing tailored treatment plans to support their recovery and well-being. Key Responsibilities Treat home care patients, including assessment and development of individualized treatment plans. Provide specialized chest physiotherapy treatments based on patients' medical conditions and therapeutic needs. Conduct prepartum and postpartum physiotherapy exercises. Administer manual massage and medical exercises to home care patients. Be available for on-call treatment of patients as required. Implement appropriate policies and procedures to align with hospital goals, objectives, Standards of Care, and quality performance improvement initiatives. Participate in patient and family education to enhance understanding and involvement in care decisions. Perform other duties within professional knowledge and skills as directed by the Head of Physiotherapy. Qualifications and Experience Education: Essential: ** in Physical Therapy, certified by the Ministry of Health. Desirable: Master's degree or attendance at physiotherapy programs organized by a physiotherapy group. Experience: Essential: One year of experience as a physiotherapist. Desirable: Two years of experience as a physiotherapist. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on providing home care services. The role requires flexibility, including availability for on-call duties, to meet patient needs effectively.

2c04347ceb8cade0.description: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Housekeeping professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests. As an Assistant Housekeeping Manager you are responsible for managing and leading the Housekeeping Team, Department towards achieving the departmental goals and objectives. Key Responsibilities: - Ensure the standards of cleanliness and maintenance of the Hotel meet the specified requirements. - Monitor cleanliness of guest rooms, with special care for VIP and long stay Guests, and public areas to ensure compliance to the Leading Quality Assurance standards of the Hotel and monitor the release of rooms to avoid delays during check-in. - Investigate and attend to Guest complaints in a timely manner and follow up effectively to ensure Guest satisfaction. - Coordinate and monitor Preventive Maintenance Program and Spring Cleaning progress in both rooms and public areas to upkeep the properties equipment, image and upholstery. - Carry out the Employee Development related requirements for new joiners to ensure they settle in quickly. - Provide effective feedback, corrective coaching and counselling to employees based on employee performance and communicates any gross misconduct or disciplinary actions to the Department Head in order to bring the Employee back on the right track. - Assist Director of Housekeeping and Assistant Director of Housekeeping with the Performance Management process activities i.e. setting of KJRs, conducting Mid Year Reviews and APR to enhance performance. - Prepare the roster for employees directly reporting to them and clear pending days, annual leave and public holidays to ensure effective operation. - Maintain a safe and hazard free environment for Guests and employees by communicating any faulty equipment or dangerous situations to the Engineering, Security Department and open the safety box of check-out, vacant rooms to ensure safety of Guest belongings. - Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly way to protect guests' and employees' health and safety, as well as protect and conserve the environment. - Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures. Education, Qualifications and Experience You should be a college or university graduate with at least three years previous management experience within the Housekeeping Department of a hotel. Technically you will have fluency in both written and spoken English, whereby additional language skills would be a definite benefit and knowledge of Micros and Opera coupled with administration and organizational computer literacy skills is essential. Knowledge and Competencies The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong professional with an eye for detail and a passion for high-quality hotel keeping. You will be self-motivated, flexible and creative in order to develop innovative options in the best interest of guests and the hotel and should possess the following additional competencies - Understanding the Business - Influencing Outcomes - Planning for Business - Team Building - Valuing Diversity - Leading People - Adaptability - Drive for Results - Customer Focus - Managing Operations

2c2254ec2b4be8ae.description: About Horizontal Digital Horizontal Digital is a digital consultancy focused on creating intuitive and empathetic customer experiences. The company develops websites, applications, and portals by integrating strategy, data, design, and technology to meet client needs. Role Overview: Salesforce Technical Lead Horizontal Digital is seeking a Salesforce Technical Lead to manage the technical delivery of a large-scale, integration-heavy Salesforce program for a major enterprise client in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and is based in Riyadh or Jeddah. The Technical Lead will collaborate with various project stakeholders, including consultants, development leads, business analysts, technical architects, project managers, client teams, and third-party vendors, to analyze requirements, assess risks, shape solutions, and ensure successful implementation. Key Responsibilities Lead the technical delivery of Salesforce workstreams, from solution design through development, deployment, and go-live. Conduct technical discovery and design sessions with clients, translating business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions and technical documentation. Provide guidance to project teams and stakeholders on technical roadmap, architecture, and platform considerations. Lead and mentor a team of developers, including delegating tasks, reviewing deliverables, and maintaining development quality and coding standards. Manage the development lifecycle, encompassing technical plans, risks, dependencies, timelines, and resourcing. Collaborate with project managers, solution consultants, and clients to align technical delivery with project goals, budgets, timelines, and expectations. Serve as the technical liaison between development teams, project leadership, and client stakeholders. Drive agile/Scrum delivery and adapt technical plans based on evolving business and project needs. Maintain technical documentation, facilitate knowledge transfer, ensure code quality, and promote development best practices. Act as a Salesforce technical adviser and subject-matter expert, supporting solution discussions, business development, and complex technical challenges. Stay informed about Salesforce platform capabilities, architecture patterns, and emerging technologies. Required Qualifications and Experience Experience: Over 10 years of proven experience as a Technical Lead or Technical Architect on enterprise Salesforce implementations. Solution Design: Strong experience in designing and delivering complex Salesforce solutions and integrations with third-party and client systems. Methodologies: Demonstrated success in delivering multiple Salesforce implementations using agile/iterative methods. Salesforce Expertise: Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture and the broader CRM ecosystem. Technical Leadership: Experience leading technical design sessions, defining deliverables, and producing technical documentation. Translation Skills: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and scalable architectures. Soft Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Business Development: Experience contributing to business development and pre-sales discussions as a Salesforce SME. Certifications: Active Salesforce certifications, or willingness to obtain relevant ones. Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Location: Based in, or willing to relocate to, Riyadh or Jeddah, with willingness to travel to client sites as needed. Preferred Skills and Experience Arabic language skills. Hands-on experience with Amadeus Digital Integration Hub (DIH), including its event and data model, topics, and schemas. Experience building on Kafka / Confluent event streaming, including consumer groups, Schema Registry, and Avro/JSON serialization. Experience integrating with Amadeus Web Services and APIs. Experience building data transformation and mapping logic, particularly from nested JSON and EDIFACT into a canonical relational model. Background in travel, aviation, or hospitality programs. Previous delivery experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region. Technical Expertise Strong experience in solution architecture, design, and development within Salesforce. Proficiency in building custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, integrations, web services, and data migration. Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, platform and governor limits, APIs, security, data, and integration patterns. Experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, with exposure to Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft. Comfortable across the full Salesforce implementation lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development and deployment. Ability to leverage AI tools such as Claude Code across the delivery lifecycle to accelerate design and development, analyze impact, and ensure safe validation and rollout of changes.

2c7b24d25e101baa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار مكه للاستشارات الهندسية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحليل عناصر المشروع، ووضع الخطط الزمنية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى إدارة التدفق النقدي والمخاطر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل عناصر وفعاليات المشروع، وتحديد ارتباطاتها وترتيبها، ودراسة قيمة المشروع وحجمه. إعداد البرامج الزمنية للمشاريع وترتيب الإجراءات اللازمة لتنفيذها. تحديد الموارد المادية والبشرية المطلوبة للمشروع ومتابعة توفيرها في التوقيتات المناسبة. إعداد جداول التدفق النقدي بما يتناسب مع تسلسل تنفيذ فعاليات المشروع. مراجعة التقدم الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالبرنامج المخطط، وإعداد البرامج المعدلة والمنقحة. تطوير أساليب وتقنيات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة لتحسين كفاءة إدارة المشاريع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة المشاريع، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح التقارير والوثائق، وحفظها في قواعد البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على تحليل المخاطر المتوقعة ووضع استراتيجيات التخفيف منها. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير واستخدام برامج الأوفيس. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية ممتازة لتحديد عناصر المشروع وارتباطاتها. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال للموارد والجداول الزمنية. مهارات تواصل وعرض قوية لتقديم التقارير والتوصيات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتطوير أساليب العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة دار مكه للاستشارات الهندسية، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

Benefits include competitive compensation and premium health insurance within a supportive, high-performance environment. The role involves collaboration with AI scientists, engineers, and industry experts in an inclusive culture that values diversity and innovation.

2cd8585001aebd3f.description: About ABYAT ABYAT, established in September 2005 in Kuwait, is the largest retail store in the Middle East specializing in home improvement products, offering over 22,000 items. The company is currently expanding its operations into Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE. We are seeking dedicated professionals to join our team in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. The Role: Logistics Supervisor The Logistics Supervisor will oversee and manage daily logistics operations to ensure the efficient movement, transportation, storage, and distribution of goods throughout the company's supply chain network. This full-time role involves coordinating inbound and outbound shipments, managing transportation activities and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, and optimizing delivery operations to ensure cost-effective and timely distribution to warehouses, showrooms, and customers. Key Responsibilities Supervise inbound shipments from local and international suppliers, ensuring timely receipt of goods. Coordinate with procurement, suppliers, freight forwarders, and customs clearance teams to monitor shipment progress and resolve delays or discrepancies. Oversee daily outbound logistics operations, including order dispatching, delivery scheduling, and distribution to various destinations. Ensure timely and accurate deliveries, monitor delivery performance, and address delivery complaints or issues. Manage and monitor third-party logistics providers, transportation companies, and delivery contractors, ensuring compliance with service levels and company standards. Optimize delivery routes and vehicle utilization to improve operational efficiency and reduce transportation costs. Coordinate with warehouse teams for smooth inbound and outbound goods movement, monitoring loading/unloading activities and ensuring proper handling. Monitor and report logistics Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), identify improvement opportunities, and ensure compliance with regulations. Supervise, guide, and evaluate logistics team members to achieve operational targets. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. 3–5 years of relevant experience in logistics operations, preferably within the retail, furniture, home furnishing, manufacturing, or distribution industries. Previous experience supervising logistics teams and managing daily transportation and distribution activities. Hands-on experience managing 3PL providers, transporters, and logistics service contractors. Good knowledge of inbound and outbound logistics, shipment coordination, and last-mile delivery operations. Experience handling high-volume shipments and multiple delivery destinations. Understanding of warehouse operations, inventory movements, and logistics documentation. Experience using ERP systems, preferably SAP, and proficiency in Microsoft Excel and logistics reporting tools. Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety standards, and operational compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, requiring active involvement in daily logistics operations and coordination across various teams and external partners.

2cd96689ebbca718.description: About the Role National Contracting Company (NCC), part of Rezayat Group’s E&C Cluster, is seeking an experienced Assistant Manager for Mechanical Industrial Construction. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia and involves leading site mechanical works and equipment installation for NCC T&D KSA projects. Key Responsibilities Monitor mechanical works and equipment installation to ensure alignment with approved procedures. Review mechanical drawings and oversee the submission of As-Built drawings to the client. Plan and schedule works, and prepare necessary Method Statements, Rigging Plans, and Work Procedures. Lead mechanical teams, ensuring effective management of manpower and resources. Ensure full compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements. Coordinate effectively with Planning teams, Project teams, clients, and subcontractors. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical industrial construction. Proven ability to lead site mechanical works and equipment installation. Strong understanding of mechanical drawings and construction procedures. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site leadership for mechanical works within industrial construction projects. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

2cdb9f16d536d1c4.description: About Gathern Gathern is a Saudi company that has established itself as a leader in the alternative hospitality sector within the Kingdom. As the largest peer-to-peer vacation rental marketplace in Saudi Arabia, Gathern facilitates authentic stays hosted by local residents, supporting Saudi Vision 2030 by enhancing tourism and expanding accommodation options. The company recently completed a SAR 270 million Series B funding round, valuing Gathern at over SAR 1 billion, and is preparing for a future Tadawul listing. With over 5 million users, guests from more than 150 nationalities, and a network of over 72,000 hospitality units, Gathern has processed over SAR 2 billion in payments to more than 33,000 Saudi hosts. The company holds a 44% national market share and 53% in Riyadh. The Role: Director of Growth Gathern is seeking an experienced Director of Growth to develop data-driven growth strategies, identify new market opportunities, and drive customer acquisition and retention. This full-time role requires expertise in customer segmentation and an understanding of consumer behavior, with the ability to lead cross-functional marketing teams to achieve measurable business growth. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive growth strategies to drive guest acquisition, activation, retention, and overall business growth. Lead customer and market segmentation initiatives to identify high-potential audiences and uncover new growth opportunities across Saudi Arabia. Analyze customer behavior, booking patterns, and market trends to develop targeted marketing strategies and improve customer engagement. Optimize the customer acquisition funnel, improving conversion rates from initial search and signup through reservations and repeat bookings. Oversee Performance Marketing, CRM, and SEO functions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and growth priorities. Drive customer retention and repeat bookings through lifecycle marketing, personalized campaigns, and marketing automation. Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across relevant channels, maximizing reach, engagement, and return on investment. Manage marketing budgets efficiently, optimizing customer acquisition costs (CAC) and ensuring strong marketing ROI. Establish and monitor growth KPIs, leveraging data analytics and experimentation to continuously improve performance. Build, mentor, and lead high-performing growth teams, establishing clear objectives, accountability, and effective operating processes. Collaborate with Product, Data, Technology, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and enhance the customer journey. Continuously evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging growth opportunities to strengthen Gathern's market position. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. Extensive experience in Growth Marketing, Growth Strategy, or related leadership roles. Proven expertise in Customer Segmentation and Market Segmentation, with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable growth strategies. Strong understanding of the Saudi consumer market, customer behavior, and local market dynamics. Demonstrated success in driving customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and measurable business growth. Solid knowledge of Performance Marketing, CRM, SEO, and marketing automation, with experience overseeing specialized teams. Strong analytical skills and experience using customer data, market research, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions. Experience managing marketing budgets, optimizing acquisition costs, and maximizing marketing ROI. Proven leadership experience managing teams and collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. Strategic mindset, strong commercial acumen, and a results-driven approach to identifying and capturing growth opportunities.

2c00bc6d891a3e38.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مسار الرمال للتجارة والمقاولات العامة عن كهربائي مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح الأنظمة الكهربائية في مختلف المباني والهياكل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب الأسلاك الكهربائية، والأجهزة، والتجهيزات في المباني والهياكل الأخرى. صيانة وتصليح الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية لضمان كفاءتها وسلامتها. تركيب المعدات الكهربائية المختلفة مثل الكابلات الكهربائية والأسلاك والأجهزة الأخرى داخل المباني. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال المعدات الكهربائية المعطلة مثل الكابلات الكهربائية والأسلاك والأجهزة الأخرى. استخدام مجموعة متنوعة من الأدوات اليدوية والمعدات الأساسية اللازمة لإنجاز العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الكهرباء أو صيانة المباني. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح الأسلاك والأجهزة الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مواقع المشاريع التابعة للشركة في عنيزة، القصيم. تتطلب بيئة العمل الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان إنجاز المهام بفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

2c5c21b485b74be8.description: Job Summary Cipher7 Business Consulting & Digital Solutions is seeking a Head of Transmission Lines to lead the Transmission Line business in Saudi Arabia for a prominent international engineering and infrastructure organization. This full-time senior leadership role is based in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah, and requires extensive experience in High Voltage (HV) / Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission line projects, particularly those at 380kV and above. Role Overview The successful candidate will assume overall responsibility for business operations, project execution, commercial performance, and strategic growth. This involves ensuring the successful delivery of multiple transmission line projects across Saudi Arabia, managing large-scale EPC operations, and overseeing the P&L for the business unit. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end execution of HV/EHV transmission line projects, ensuring delivery within approved budgets, timelines, quality, and HSE standards. Oversee engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities for projects. Manage the business unit's P&L, including budgeting, cash flow, profitability, and cost optimization. Lead and develop Cluster Project Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional teams. Manage senior client relationships, particularly with SEC and other key stakeholders. Oversee contract administration, commercial negotiations, claims, and variation orders. Drive operational excellence, resource optimization, and sustainable business growth. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. A minimum of 20 years of professional experience in power transmission and EPC project execution. Strong experience in delivering 380kV and above Overhead Transmission Line projects. At least 5 years of relevant experience specifically within Saudi Arabia. Extensive Middle East exposure, preferably within major utility infrastructure projects. Proven experience with full P&L ownership, commercial management, and contract administration. Demonstrated ability to lead large project teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong stakeholder management and client relationship capabilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering projects in cities such as Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a leading international engineering and infrastructure organization, managing complex projects and teams across Saudi Arabia.

2c7c71085f29040c.description: About Rixos Hotels Rixos Hotels is a global leader in hospitality, committed to supporting employee growth and learning. The company offers opportunities for individuals to find roles that align with their aspirations. Rixos Murjana, a new property in Saudi Arabia, is a 275,000 square meter all-inclusive resort designed to offer indulgence, relaxation, and adventure, redefining hotel stays in the Kingdom. The Role of P&C Coordinator Rixos Hotels is seeking a P&C Coordinator for its operations in Makkah, specifically in King Abdullah Economic City and Makkah. This full-time position reports directly to the Director of Human Resources. The P&C Coordinator is responsible for providing efficient, personalized, courteous, and timely service to all colleagues, supporting the smooth daily operation of the People & Culture Department. The role involves coordinating various Human Resources functions while ensuring compliance with hotel standards, policies, procedures, and applicable legal requirements. Key Responsibilities Maintain and update candidate databases and CV records for recruitment. Assist in the recruitment and hiring of rank-and-file employees, coordinating the entire process from interviews to arrivals. Ensure accuracy and completeness of recruitment documentation and candidate records. Coordinate with hotel departments on recruitment needs and hiring activities. Liaise with the PRO and external agencies for employee visa applications and arrangements. Coordinate new employee arrivals and ensure all joining arrangements are completed. Manage employee joiner and leaver administration, maintaining accurate and confidential employee files, records, and databases. Monitor and track annual and sick leave accruals. Coordinate employee-related activities across all hotel departments. Support the implementation and evaluation of HR practices to improve departmental efficiency. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and coordinate employee relations functions. Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Director of Human Resources, handling confidential matters, managing correspondence, and scheduling. Prepare letters, memorandums, reports, and other documents using various applications. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems. Prepare, maintain, and update HR reports, records, and departmental databases, including the Management Information System (MIS). Conduct regular audits to ensure records are accurate and up to date. Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, operational standards, and applicable legal requirements, including health, hygiene, security, safety, and fire regulations. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred. Previous experience in Human Resources or administration is required. A minimum of one year of experience in a similar role is required. Work Environment and Expectations The P&C Coordinator will work in a collaborative environment, supporting colleagues and contributing to departmental objectives. The role requires maintaining familiarity with company documentation and operational standards, adhering to service standards, and completing assigned tasks accurately and efficiently. Professionalism, accountability, and commitment to personal and professional development are expected.

2cb7c86ea3727162.description: About Fresha Fresha is a leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry. The company is expanding its commercial team and is seeking an Associate Account Manager to join its operations in Riyadh, Riyadh. Role Overview The Associate Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of Fresha partners across the Arabic-speaking market. This full-time role involves building strong relationships with existing partners, understanding their businesses, and identifying opportunities to increase the adoption and monetization of the Fresha platform. The position reports to the Account Manager Team Lead and requires balancing partner experience with revenue growth and retention. Data and account insights will be used to proactively engage partners and enhance their value from Fresha. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of existing Fresha partners, overseeing monetization, retention, and revenue growth for assigned accounts. Analyze account performance to identify opportunities for increasing product adoption, upselling relevant solutions, and growing monetized revenue. Build strong, long-term relationships with partners through proactive communication, regular video meetings, and a deep understanding of their business needs. Implement a consistent contact strategy across the portfolio to keep partners engaged with Fresha and proactively identify opportunities to reduce churn. Achieve commercial targets consistently while accurately recording account activity, opportunities, and next steps in the CRM system. Educate partners on the value of the Fresha platform, share relevant insights, and ensure they maximize the products and services available to them. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in account management or a related commercial role. Commercially motivated with a proactive approach to relationship building. Ability to work towards clear targets in a fast-paced environment. Career Development Opportunity to manage a portfolio of Fresha partners and directly impact retention, monetization, and revenue growth. Develop skills in Account Management, upselling, retention, and SaaS commercial growth. Contribute to partner success and Fresha’s continued growth during a period of global expansion. Work Environment This role is based in our Riyadh office, requiring 5 days per week of in-person interaction to foster a collaborative environment focused on teamwork and continuous improvement.

2c8f1b0270df1870.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات والمعدات الثقيلة بكفاءة، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد السلامة المرورية وإجراءات الصيانة الدورية. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات والمعدات الثقيلة مثل الشاحنات القلابة، الحفارات، المقطورات، الرافعات، والحافلات. توجيه أعمال ومشغلي المعدات الثقيلة بفعالية في الحالات الطارئة. التقيد بمسارات العمل المحددة وفقًا لخطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام الصارم بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب المخالفات النظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة والمعدات، ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للجهات المعنية عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحص الخبراء. الالتزام التام بالأدلة والإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية لا تقل عن خمس سنوات في تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات والمعدات الثقيلة. القدرة على تشغيل وقيادة أنواع مختلفة من المعدات الثقيلة. امتلاك رخصة قيادة سعودية للنقل الثقيل سارية المفعول. الكفاءة في التعامل مع الحالات الطارئة وتوجيه فريق العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة ضمن فريق مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه في مدينة ينبع بالمدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل، مع التركيز على تطبيق معايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام الموكلة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة ممتازة للمركبات والمعدات الثقيلة. القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات سريعة وفعالة في المواقف الطارئة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. مهارات التواصل الأساسية لرفع تقارير الصيانة والتنسيق مع الزملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه.

2c126d2ef2558dbe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مواقع النجوم للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة، وتحديداً في ينبع. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، من التخطيط وتوزيع المهام إلى تقييم الأداء وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مشرف الصيانة مسؤولية قيادة فريق الصيانة وضمان كفاءة العمليات. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تصميم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفريق الصيانة وتقييمها، والتوصية ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة لتنمية مهاراتهم. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيانة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إعداد خطط العمل وبرامج الصيانة. مهارات جيدة في توزيع المهام وإدارة الفريق. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم البرامج المناسبة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة مواقع النجوم للمقاولات في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل الميداني والإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في مجال المقاولات. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

2c8aeceec326c1aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برافو للمقاولات عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة وإنجاز المعاملات والإجراءات الحكومية المتعلقة بالمنشأة والموظفين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة المعاملات عبر المنصات الحكومية الإلكترونية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة وإنجاز جميع المعاملات الحكومية الخاصة بالمنشأة والموظفين من خلال المنصات الإلكترونية المعتمدة (مثل قوى، مقيم، أبشر أعمال، التأمينات الاجتماعية، وغيرها). التنسيق الفعال مع الجهات الحكومية المختصة ومتابعة الطلبات لضمان استكمالها في الوقت المحدد. ضمان إنجاز كافة المعاملات في مواعيدها المحددة، مع الالتزام التام بالأنظمة والتعليمات المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. متابعة المستجدات والتحديثات في الإجراءات والمتطلبات الحكومية وتطبيقها بشكل فوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالعلاقات الحكومية أو متابعة المعاملات. الإلمام الجيد بقوانين نظام العمل السعودي والأنظمة الحكومية ذات الصلة. القدرة على استخدام المنصات الحكومية الإلكترونية بفعالية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. دقة عالية في إنجاز المهام والالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية. مهارات تواصل قوية للتنسيق مع الجهات الحكومية المختلفة. القدرة على التكيف مع التغييرات في الإجراءات والأنظمة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب الحضور المنتظم في مقر الشركة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات الإدارية والقانونية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2cbb476606323d6b.description: About the Role CHAMP Cargosystems is seeking a Senior Product Analyst to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position reports directly to a Product Manager and involves translating customer needs into product requirements and supporting the delivery of solutions. Key Responsibilities Capture, clarify, and translate customer needs into actionable product requirements to reduce ambiguity and improve delivery readiness. Own and maintain the Scrum team backlog, ensuring priorities, user stories, and acceptance criteria are clear, current, and prepared for sprint planning. Define functional and integration requirements that support customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and product roadmap objectives. Analyze requirements and recommend scalable solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, and long-term maintainability. Own assigned business domain modules, aligning stakeholders on documented solutions for consistent implementation and reuse. Lead delivery activities from inception to go-live, coordinating analysts, developers, and stakeholders to support on-time, quality releases. Mentor business analysts and development teams to improve Agile delivery practices, requirement quality, and solution consistency. Prepare and maintain functional specifications, solution documentation, and support materials to enable stakeholder approval and efficient development. Define test scenarios, validate delivered functionality, and provide business acceptance to improve release quality and reduce defects. Create workflows, interface designs, and mock-ups to accelerate solution validation and improve user understanding. Investigate operational incidents and defects, identify root causes, and support corrective actions to improve system stability. Build and maintain test libraries that strengthen manual and automated regression coverage. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a similar role. 2cd4a70a5593a651.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خير الغذاء عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على تطبيق اشتراطات سلامة وجودة المنتجات الغذائية، وضمان سلامتها خلال عمليات الاستلام والتخزين والتوزيع. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية مراقبة العمليات التشغيلية لضمان مطابقتها لأنظمة السلامة الغذائية ومعايير التخزين الجيد. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطبيق نظام تحليل المخاطر ونقاط التحكم الحرجة (HACCP) وممارسات التخزين الجيد (GSP). تطوير وتحديث خطط سلامة الغذاء ونقاط التحكم الحرجة داخل المستودع. إجراء جولات تفقدية دورية (يومية وأسبوعية) للتأكد من نظافة المستودع وخلوه من الآفات. ضمان امتثال المستودع لجميع اشتراطات ومتطلبات هيئة الغذاء والدواء والجهات البلدية. فحص المواد الغذائية الواردة (السيارات، الحاويات، التغليف) والتأكد من تاريخ الصلاحية والجودة. مراقبة وتسجيل درجات الحرارة والرطوبة في غرف التبريد والتجميد والتخزين الجاف. الإشراف على تطبيق سياسة "ما تنتهي صلاحيته أولاً، يخرج أولاً" (FIFO/FEFO). تقديم دورات تدريبية دورية للعمال والسائقين حول الممارسات الصحية السليمة والنظافة الشخصية. عزل المنتجات الملوثة أو منتهية الصلاحية وسحبها فوراً وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. الاحتفاظ بسجلات دقيقة لدرجات الحرارة، عمليات التنظيف، خطط مكافحة الحشرات، وبلاغات عدم المطابقة. تمثيل المنشأة أثناء زيارات التفتيش الحكومية أو التدقيق الخارجي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لأنظمة سلامة الغذاء مثل HACCP و GSP. القدرة على إجراء التفتيش الدوري ومراقبة العمليات التشغيلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في المراقبة والتدقيق. القدرة على تدريب وتوعية الموظفين. مهارات جيدة في التوثيق وإعداد التقارير. التعامل الفعال مع الجهات الرقابية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية في مستودعات شركة خير الغذاء بالمدينة المنورة، ضمن فريق يهدف إلى حماية صحة المستهلك النهائي وضمان جودة المنتجات الغذائية. يتطلب الدور التواجد الميداني لمراقبة العمليات بشكل مستمر. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق خير الغذاء، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

2ca8be13ceb7dc3d.description: About the Role Ninja (quick-commerce) is seeking a Refurbishment Technician to join our team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role focuses on inspecting, repairing, refurbishing, and restoring reusable equipment to safe and reliable working condition. The successful candidate will contribute to extending equipment lifespan, improving operational reliability, and supporting cost-effective asset reuse across our locations. Key Responsibilities Inspect returned, damaged, or surplus equipment to identify defects, assess condition, and determine refurbishment requirements. Perform equipment refurbishment activities, including cleaning, dismantling, component replacement, minor electrical and mechanical repairs, and reassembly. Refurbish commercial upright chillers, freezers, and refrigeration equipment, including doors, hinges, gaskets, shelves, fans, and control components. Repair and restore reusable store equipment such as shelving, racks, trolleys, and fixtures. Coordinate equipment collection, workshop priorities, storage, and handover with the maintenance team and relevant departments. Support equipment installation and commissioning when required. 2caa77c756bc3ba2.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب اليمامه للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم الإشراف الهندسي للمشاريع، مع التركيز على الجوانب الميكانيكية للمباني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية الإشراف الهندسي على مشاريع المباني، مع التركيز على الهندسة الميكانيكية. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بالمواد المستخدمة ومعايير الجودة المطبقة في المشاريع. دعم المشاريع الهندسية من خلال الإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب الأنظمة الميكانيكية. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة الخاصة بالأعمال الميكانيكية للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم في جميع أعمال ميكانيكا المباني، مع الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالهندسة الميكانيكية أو الإشراف الهندسي. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق معايير الجودة والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في مواقع العمل. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.
